verifiers.name: refactor-integrity
verifiers.description: Refactors claiming pure code motion must not silently change literals, symbols, or visibility.

rules.question: In diff hunks that read as moved or extracted code, do any string literals, IR symbol names, numeric constants, or visibility qualifiers change value?
rules.pass: Literals, symbols, constants, and visibilities are unchanged in moved code
rules.fail: A move silently changes a literal, symbol, constant, or visibility (e.g. a retyped format string or a changed target triple)

verifiers.name: codegen-hygiene
verifiers.description: patch-prolog codegen policies: unwrap discipline and comment-code agreement.

rules.question: Is the list empty of added lines outside #[cfg(test)] blocks that call .unwrap() or .expect()?
rules.pass: The list is empty: no added line outside test code calls unwrap or expect, or each one is invariant-backed with a message saying why it cannot fail; unwraps inside #[cfg(test)] do not count
rules.fail: The list has at least one entry: an added line outside test code calls .unwrap() or .expect() with no invariant justification

rules.question: Do the changed doc and inline comments still accurately describe the adjacent code after this diff?
rules.pass: Changed comments match the code they annotate
rules.fail: A comment describes mechanics the code no longer has (e.g. says 'argument registers' where the code passes call operands)

verifiers.name: test-integrity
verifiers.description: Assertions are only weakened deliberately and visibly.

rules.question: Is the list empty of removed or weakened assertions and removed test cases in this diff?
rules.pass: The list is empty: no assertion is deleted or weakened, no test case removed; code moved out of the file that is not a test does not count
rules.fail: The list has at least one entry: an assertion deleted or weakened, or a test case removed
